Exact source before/after snapshots, semantic equality, destination regular nlink1 and unchanged strict rootfs inventory bind the intentional hardlink-topology transformation
Exact helper identity, command/target receipt schema, immutable fixed receipt path/hash and current source/destination verification precede per-job readonly mounts
OCI digest remains the original complete-blob image identity, with explicit trusted-build/unpack qualification and separately retained normalized-rootfs inventory/provenance
